description: This file defines the RecurrenceRule class which models recurrence scheduling rules including frequency, interval, and constraints for date calculations and validations. It provides methods for creating rules, calculating next recurrence times, and validating date applicability based on specified rule parameters.

classes.name: RecurrenceRule
classes.description: Represents a recurrence rule with various frequency and timing constraints, capable of computing and validating recurrence dates.

methods.name: RecurrenceRule
methods.description: Constructs a RecurrenceRule object from a GenericValue entity, initializing rule properties.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the recurrence rule by validating and parsing configuration parameters from the provided GenericValue.

methods.name: checkFreq
methods.description: Validates if the given frequency string matches accepted recurrence frequency constants.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the recurrence's end time or -1 if none exists.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the recurrence will occur or 0 if unlimited.

methods.name: getFrequencyName
methods.description: Returns the recurrence frequency as an uppercase string.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Retrieves the recurrence frequency as an integer constant.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval between recurrences.

methods.name: getIntervalInt
methods.description: Returns the interval as an integer value.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next recurrence time after a given start and reference time, considering count and end time constraints.

methods.name: validCurrent
methods.description: Checks if the current time, based on a start time, is a valid recurrence occurrence as per the rules.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Determines if a specified date falls within the recurrence rules.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes this recurrence rule from persistent storage.

methods.name: getNextFreq
methods.description: Computes the next recurrence date based on the start time and a reference point, advancing in frequency steps.

methods.name: validByRule
methods.description: Validates a date against all specified byXXX constraints in the rule.

methods.name: hasNumber
methods.description: Checks if a string begins with a numeric sign or digit.

methods.name: getDailyNumber
methods.description: Extracts the numeric modifier from a day string (e.g., '2MO' -> 2).

methods.name: getDailyString
methods.description: Produces the day string portion excluding the numeric modifier.

methods.name: getCalendarDay
methods.description: Converts day abbreviation (e.g., 'MO') to Calendar day constant.

methods.name: primaryKey
methods.description: Returns the primary key identifier for this recurrence rule.

methods.name: makeRule
methods.description: Factory method to create a new RecurrenceRule with specified frequency, interval, count, or end time.
